title: pumas_limiter_update: droplet freezing limiter for PUMAS cloud microphysics in CESM 2.1.5
description: Port of the droplet freezing limiter of mg2_limiter_update to the PUMAS cloud microphysics in CESM 2.1.5, applied on top of PUMAS_interface_215. The repository contains patches for PUMAS and CAM, the namelist of the DustOnly-NieSing-PUMAS simulations of Villanueva et al. (in review) and a script that applies both patch sets.

creators.name: Villanueva, Diego
